question: In the Li3PO4-coated NCM study, how much did the charge-transfer resistance rise over 50 cycles for the bare and the coated material, and what capacity did each retain after 100 cycles at 1C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%Li3PO4%' OR text ILIKE '%Li3PO%' OR text ILIKE '%charge transfer%' OR text ILIKE '%charge-transfer%' OR text ILIKE '%Rct%' OR text ILIKE '%R_ct%' ORDER BY page, id LIMIT 150
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE page=8 AND kind LIKE '%line%' OR (page=8 AND id LIKE 'p8.L%') ORDER BY id

SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (8,9) AND (text ILIKE '%capacity%' OR text ILIKE '%retain%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%100 cycles%' OR text ILIKE '%Rct%' OR text ILIKE '%Fig. 5%' OR text ILIKE '%50%') ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT ROUND(CAST(regexp_extract(b.text, 'to ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(b.text, 'from ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS bare_rise, ROUND(CAST(regexp_extract(l.text, 'to ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(l.text, 'from ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS lpo_rise FROM atoms b, atoms l WHERE b.id='p8.L38' AND l.id='p8.L40'

rendered: Charge-transfer resistance, bare NCM: it rose by 196.05[1] ohm over the cycles, per the document's statement that Rct increased from 27.99 to 224.04[2] during 50 cycles[3]. LPO-coated NCM: it rose by 129.87[4] ohm, since it increased from 14.88 to 144.75[5]. Capacity retention when cycled at 1C between 2.8-4.5 V[6]: bare NCM retaining 75.4% of its initial discharge capacity after 100 cycles[7], and LPO-coated NCM capacity retention of 88.4%[8].
